description: This Java class 'ProductsController' manages web requests related to product administration in an e-commerce platform. It includes methods for displaying product pages, handling product data pagination, deleting products, and setting menu attributes for views. It utilizes Spring MVC annotations, dependency injection, and interacts with services for categories and products.

classes.name: ProductsController
classes.description: Spring MVC controller class handling product management admin functionalities such as viewing, paging, and deleting products.

methods.name: displayProducts
methods.description: Handles GET requests to display the products page, setting up categories and menu state.

methods.name: pageProducts
methods.description: Handles POST requests to provide paginated product data in JSON format, applying various filters and retrieving product information.

methods.name: deleteProduct
methods.description: Handles POST requests to delete a specified product, ensuring it belongs to the current store.

methods.name: setMenu
methods.description: Configures the menu state and active items for the admin view.
